tests.name: Security rules
tests.input:
set rulebase security rules ALLOW-WEB-INBOUND from UNTRUST to DMZ source any destination WEB-SERVER-01 application web-browsing action allow log-end yes
set rulebase security rules ALLOW-WEB-INBOUND from UNTRUST to DMZ source any destination WEB-SERVER-02 application ssl action allow log-end yes
set rulebase security rules ALLOW-DB-ACCESS from DMZ to TRUST source WEB-SERVER-01 destination DB-CLUSTER application mysql action allow log-end yes
set rulebase security rules DENY-DMZ-TO-MGMT from DMZ to MGMT source any destination MGMT-SUBNET application any action deny log-end yes
set rulebase security rules ALLOW-MGMT-SSH from MGMT to any source 10.10.5.0/24 destination any application ssh action allow

tests.name: NAT rules with source and destination translation
tests.input:
set rulebase nat rules OUTBOUND-SNAT from TRUST to UNTRUST source 10.100.0.0/16 destination any service any sat type dynamic-ip-and-port translated-address 203.0.120.40
set rulebase nat rules INBOUND-WEB-DNAT from UNTRUST to UNTRUST source any destination 203.0.120.41 service service-http sat type static-ip translated-address 10.100.10.50
set rulebase nat rules INBOUND-MAIL-DNAT from UNTRUST to UNTRUST source any destination 203.0.120.42 service service-smtp sat type static-ip translated-address 10.100.30.25
